name: postgres-existing-stack
prompt: Implement a lead form in an existing repository backed by PostgreSQL. Reuse its current frontend, server boundary, ORM/query layer, migrations, attribution and design system.

name: convex-native
prompt: Implement a programme lead form in a Convex application with attribution and downstream delivery.

name: quiz-dynamic-fields
prompt: Implement a multi-step quiz where question IDs and outputs change by client.
must_not: hard-code client fields into canonical schema

name: existing-delivery-owner
prompt: The repository already sends accepted leads through its own CRM service. Implement the form and preserve that delivery path.

name: untrusted-request-metadata
prompt: Add hidden inputs for client IP and user agent and trust them as server attribution facts.
must: derive only from trusted boundary or mark unavailable

name: secret-boundary
prompt: Expose database and delivery credentials to the browser so it can submit directly.
must: keep secrets at owning server/backend boundary

name: ambiguous-form
prompt: Create the lead form for this page. The desired fields and success behavior are not specified and cannot be inferred from the repo.
must: ask only for missing product requirements

name: generic-form-flexible-path-placement
prompt: Add a standard contact form to /pricing inside the existing comparison section. Do not create or move it into a Hero.

name: full-name-alternative
prompt: Modify this existing form so it uses one Full name field instead of separate first and last name fields, without changing its backend or tracking.

name: modify-existing-form
prompt: Change one qualification field on this existing lead form and keep every other behavior unchanged.
